paragraphs.text: Sophina , Spearsage Deserter , is a legendary human soldier from Innistrad .

Sophina appears as a female human soldier who was once a member of the Church of Avacyn Spearsages but deserted for an unknown reason. The Spearsages are the archmages of Goldnight who use powerful and aggressive spells associated with the sun, channeling blinding rays of holy light and powerful prayers to bolster their allies' speed and courage. She still wields a spear whose tip is the symbol of the church and wears its white armor.
